parcalar.metin: [gerilim] November 13, 2026. With thirty-five hundred planes in the air, controllers suddenly couldn't hear their pilots.
[vurgu] Seventeen of twenty-two control centers went dark... and the FAA stopped every departure in the country!
[anlatici] No hacker. No attack. A single new router in Arkansas flooded the network with connection attempts.
[gizem] But here's the real shock... it had happened before, thirty-five years ago!
[anlatici] September 17, 1991, New York. A power failure hit an AT&T switching center in Manhattan.
[gerilim] Air traffic ran over those phone lines. Controllers at Kennedy, LaGuardia and Newark lost their pilots.
[anlatici] Three airports shut down for hours. Thousands were stranded in terminals and on planes sitting on the runway.
[soru] The fix? A backup network of microwave dishes, built right alongside the phone lines.
[vurgu] Thirty-five years later, copper became fiber... but the weak spot never moved: one single box!
[vurgu] New wires... same fear! Follow Black Box Files for the next case.
